title: One evaluation pipeline the fairness gate certifies, observed sessions included
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: run_evaluation returns EvaluationRun whose fallback_reasons is r04's FallbackReasons (.codes intact); parity case asserts result, perStepSources, confidence AND fallbackReason + every ledger code (FaultProvider wrong_shape) equal between run_evaluation and the CLI envelope; observed family is ONE fixed template per BEHAVIOR replicated to n. Write set shrunk: test_devcase_eval.py untouched (its existing assertions stay green unchanged); observed-gate cases live in the new test module. Canary term capped at CANARY_VERIFY_WEIGHT 0.5 (MAX, never lowers) rather than full weight: case-sim round 3 shows canaries are not durable vs a trap-sweeping delegator, and full weight would have lifted that round's delegator ABOVE its verifier. Strength/concern lines say 'known defects in the starter code' (not 'planted') because the bullets reach the candidate's feedback letter. The dropped reflect.py 'Adjacent S finding' was not touched (fixed by e00c802fc).
notes: Case 6 (flagged==addressed, unverifiable==none) was vacuously green before (the term did not exist), hence 6 of 7 red. Refactor commit verified BYTE-IDENTICAL CLI stdout (evaluate-submission + reflect-commits, --lang cs, casesim-shaped fixture) before/after. Scores (keyless, n=48): commit path UNCHANGED (fairness pass verify lead 37.5 / ai gap 16.7; discrimination strong 48.9 weak 36.2 gamer 37.6). Observed path (new): fairness pass (verifiers 85.0 vs 0.0, ai gap +20.0), discrimination pass (86.1 / 17.9 / 12.4). Casesim fixtures (14 bundles, 3 rounds, keyless CLI): 13 unchanged; session-data-plane/delegator judgment 20->50, transfer 29->38 (its one gradable canary reads 'addressed'; the round's report declares its canary verdicts void), ranking kept (38 < minimal 58 < verifier 64). submission_eval run_one now also runs mint_followups (the production chain) - one extra LLM call per row on the --llm path, none keyless. Keyless observed rows report source 'partial' (tooling step is 'observed'), same as the production envelope; no gate reads it as LLM. test:perf exit 1 is NOT mine: overages are TS import-graph ceilings on app/api routes from a sibling's uncommitted app/_lib/candidate-population.ts / profile files; this card touched no TS. Slot B (wave 2): evaluate.deterministic now has a canary block + two _DET keys; submission_eval.run_one reads res from run_evaluation and Row has observed_checks - Row.overall untouched. consult-check hook listed eval-harness etc. as unread (non-blocking).
